messages:
maya: flagged by nightly eval — commonsense prompt set failure. accuracy dropped ~9% vs baseline, lots of nonsensical subject swaps. https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly/177255 :eyes:
ci-bot: nightly-eval completed for redwood-open-7b (build 2026-03-19T03:12Z). regression detected: +8% failure rate compared to previous run. report: https://ci.internal/redwood/reports/177255
maya: @liam any recent changes in the serving runtime around attention or RNG?
liam: I merged an attention micro-opt on Mar 18 (commit 9a7f3b2). It touched causal mask loop ordering and shifted RNG consumption in the GPU kernel for perf. Could affect sampling determinism.
zach: quick local repro steps:
```
MODEL=redwood-open-7b-nightly
python -m eval.run --model $MODEL --prompt-set commonsense --seed 42 --n=200
```
Outputs differ even with same seed. repro across 3 different nodes.
anya: pasted sanitized examples from failing prompts:
- expected: "He placed the apple in the basket because it was ripe."
- actual:   "The basket placed the apple because it was ripe."  (agent/subject swap)
maya: also seeing higher top-k diversity and more incoherent referents. looks like sampling stream is off. :thinking_face:
liam: that commit switched to per-thread PCG with a skip-ahead to avoid contention. suspect an off-by-one when advancing state in multi-kernel launches.
ci-bot: deploy job redwood-runtime-v1.4.3 -> canary @ 2026-03-19T04:00Z (deployed by deploy-bot)
zach: bisect plan: range 9a7f3b2..e2c4d5f. I'll run bisection on nightly-run harness and report the first bad commit.
liam: if bisect confirms, we should revert micro-opt and cut a patch to restore deterministic sampling. also add a regression unit test that verifies deterministic outputs with fixed seed across kernels.
maya: ran quick canary with a local revert patch — commonsense metrics returned to baseline in a small sample :white_check_mark:. gist: https://gist.github.com/maya/regen-sample
liam: opened PR with fix + test: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3124 — fixes RNG advance in attention kernel and adds deterministic sampling test in CI.
anya: scheduling a full nightly rerun (fp16 + int8 quant paths) to verify fix across codegen/quantized kernels. will update alert if green.
zach: note: quantized kernels changed memory layout; please make sure RNG offsets are consistent for int8 path too. I reproduced a smaller but present diff on int8.
liam: good catch, will run unit test on both paths.
maya: TL;DR — likely root cause: RNG advance change from attention micro-opt; working patch + PR, plan to revert in prod if CI fails. filing incident ticket RED-1234 to track rollback & postmortem.
deploy-bot: rollback prepared as release redwood-runtime-v1.4.2-rollback
maya: thanks everyone, coordinating follow-up and postmortem. :thumbsup:
